product_risk_or_requirement: Public-road injury risk from operation outside the approved ODD or without a meaningful takeover path
current_state: No approved ODD safety case or demonstrated operator-takeover protocol exists.
product_requirement: The product must block an autonomous test when ODD, critical sensor, or operator-availability evidence is outside the approved policy and must preserve a human takeover record.
acceptance_criteria: Given a supervised test has an ODD breach or critical sensor fault When the operator console receives the event Then the system blocks continued autonomous testing, records the safety-driver response, and requires Fleet Safety Lead approval before resumption.
evidence_needed: Approved ODD safety case; tabletop and route scenario results; sampled takeover records.

product_risk_or_requirement: Automation complacency and mode confusion can defeat nominal human oversight
current_state: No independent evidence shows operators understand alerts, limits, or authority under workload.
product_requirement: The product must provide an evidence-rich alert, explicit decision authority, and independent scenario testing for alert burden and mode comprehension.
acceptance_criteria: Given a safety operator receives an alert during a workload scenario When an independent assessor observes the exercise Then the operator can identify the evidence, pause the test within the target time, and correctly state the authority to override.
evidence_needed: Independent scenario-test report, operator training completion, alert-disposition time distribution, and remediation record.

product_risk_or_requirement: Safety, privacy, incident reporting, and market-scope obligations are not yet assessed for the exact system boundary
current_state: Transport approvals, personal-data roles, retention, and EU product-law applicability have not been confirmed.
product_requirement: Legal and privacy owners must approve a jurisdiction-specific launch memo and incident-reporting protocol before public-road processing or market expansion.
acceptance_criteria: Given the final system boundary and data-flow diagram are available When legal and privacy review is conducted Then the owners document applicable obligations, approved retention and transfer controls, and any regulator-notification path before release.
deadline_or_trigger: Before collection of public-road pilot data or EU market activity
evidence_needed: Signed legal/privacy launch memo; data-flow record; retention schedule; incident-notification decision tree.

product_risk_or_requirement: Residual risk acceptance and post-incident restart authority must be independent of delivery pressure
current_state: A draft process exists but no independent restart-veto test has been performed.
product_requirement: The release process must give the Chief Safety Officer and independent assessor authority to pause or veto restart after an incident.
acceptance_criteria: Given a serious incident is logged When a restart is proposed Then the workflow prevents restart without recorded Chief Safety Officer approval and independent-assessor disposition.
deadline_or_trigger: Any collision, near miss, or material model change
evidence_needed: Governance drill record and sampled restart approvals.
